description.en:
This parameter is the temperature of air at 2m above the surface of land, sea or in-land waters.

2m temperature is calculated by interpolating between the lowest model level and the Earth's surface, taking account of the atmospheric conditions. See further information .

This parameter has units of kelvin (K). Temperature measured in kelvin can be converted to degrees Celsius (°C) by subtracting 273.15.

Please note that the encodings listed here for s2s & uerra (which includes encodings for carra/cerra) include entries for Mean 2 metre temperature. The specific encoding for Mean 2 metre temperature can be found in 228004.
